gloss: piggy bank; coin bank; money box

definitions.gloss: piggy bank; coin bank; money box
definitions.explanation: A container, often shaped like an animal, used for saving coins. A familiar household item, especially for children learning to save money.

examples.japanese: {貯金箱|ちょきんばこ}にお{金|かね}を{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I put money in the piggy bank.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}がブタの{貯金箱|ちょきんばこ}を{持|も}っている。
examples.english: The child has a pig-shaped piggy bank.

examples.japanese: {貯金箱|ちょきんばこ}を{割|わ}ったら、{三万円|さんまんえん}も{入|はい}っていた。
examples.english: When I broke open the piggy bank, there was 30,000 yen inside.

notes:
USAGE:
A common everyday word. Traditional Japanese {貯金箱|ちょきんばこ} come in various shapes; some are designed to be broken open ({割|わ}る) when full.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貯金箱|ちょきんばこ}にお{金|かね}を{入|い}れる (to put money in a piggy bank)
- {貯金箱|ちょきんばこ}を{割|わ}る (to break open a piggy bank)
- {貯金箱|ちょきんばこ}が{一杯|いっぱい}になる (for a piggy bank to become full)

WORD FORMATION:
{貯金|ちょきん} (savings) + {箱|はこ} (box). The は becomes ば due to rendaku.
